content:
alex chen: Quick check — planning a percent+region canary for new v8-multi model. Proposal: NA: 1% -> 5% over 3h (step 1% every 30m), EU: 0.5% -> 3% next day. Also want to only enable multimodal inference path (tag=multimodal) initially. Any red flags?

maya singh: sounds reasonable. couple asks: 1) fallback behavior if latencies spike 2) how will quota slices be enforced for dedicated vs hosted customers? :thinking_face:

kevin lo: for fallback we should auto-route to v8-text fallback variant (same params, no image encoder) + surface a metric. I can wire an automatic cutoff at 95th latency p95 > 500ms for 10m.

priya rao: +1 on cutoff. also request: add canary_safety_check webhook to the rollout so experiments can abort automatically. pinging @oncall jordan to confirm escalation window.

oncall jordan: oncall here — +1 on automatic cutoff. please make the abort path call /api/op/abort-rollout and page oncall if abort triggered for >2 consecutive checks. keep the first NA window during business hours (13:00-16:00 PST) so we have folks online.

alex chen: good call. plan is to schedule NA window tomorrow 14:00 PST. Kevin can you push the rollout config? Priya can you add the safety webhook? I'll file the small CR for the routing change.

kevin lo: putting a draft rollout config here. let me know if the names/labels look ok:

```json
{
  "toggle": "model.v8.multimodal.canary",
  "targets": [
    {"region": "us-west-2", "pct": 1},
    {"region": "us-east-1", "pct": 0}
  ],
  "phases": [
    {"duration_mins": 30, "step_pct": 1},
    {"duration_mins": 30, "step_pct": 1},
    {"duration_mins": 30, "step_pct": 1},
    {"duration_mins": 60, "step_pct": 2}
  ],
  "filters": {"tag": "multimodal"},
  "safety_hooks": ["canary_safety_check_webhook"]
}
```

maya singh: a couple nits: rename toggle to model.v8.multimodal.slice.canary and add explicit "fallback_model":"v8-text-fallback" field. Also add a quota cap per-customer (e.g., 500 requests/min) for the first 24h.

priya rao: adding the webhook skeleton. sample curl to register:

```bash
curl -X POST https://rollout.internal/api/hooks \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"canary_safety_check_webhook","url":"https://ops.example.com/rollout-check","events":["latency","error_rate"]}'
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rollout created by kevin lo for toggle model.v8.multimodal.slice.canary starting 2026-03-18T14:00:00Z -> phase plan accepted.

kevin lo: I updated the config with names and fallback + quota cap. pushing PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rollout/pull/410 (small change, tests included). can someone quick review?

alex chen: I'll review in a bit. Priya, can you ensure the webhook returns 200 when checks pass? We should also log the webhook responses to the canary audit stream.

priya rao: will do. adding logging and a retry/backoff. also adding an annotation in the PR for required oncall contacts.

maya singh: ops question — for dedicated customers, quota enforcement needs a mapping from customer_id -> cap. do we have that exported to the rollout service or do we need a new lookup?

kevin lo: rollout service will call customer-quotas service. I'll add a call with caching TTL 30s. fallback if lookup fails: default global cap = 200 req/min.

oncall jordan: reminder: please include a rollback playbook in the PR description with exact steps and required comms. if we need to cut traffic immediately, prefer to set pct=0 for the toggle rather than delete config. paging policy should be in the playbook.

alex chen: agreed. I'll add playbook to the PR. final ask: share expected telemetry dashboards (p95 latency, error rate, top-k model fallbacks) so SRE can watch.

priya rao: adding dashboard links to PR description.

alex chen: cool — thanks everyone. Kevin will kick at 14:00 PST tomorrow. if anything changes, update this thread and ping @maya. :rocket:
